25838.description:
About Us
Seaside Developments Ltd T/A PNG Concrete Aggregates (a 100% nationally owned company) Serving Papua New Guinea for over 15 years, have become reliable business partners and suppliers to the construction industry nationwide.  We provide high quality products and services that conform to local and international standards. We have manufacturing and distribution capabilities in Port Moresby and Lae and are versatile to all customer requirements.
Position
We’re seeking to recruits two results-driven professionals for the position of
Operations Manager
for our Port Moresby & Lae offices.
The Operations Manager will oversee the daily operations of Construction Projects, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with Safety Regulations.   The Operations Manager will coordinate between various departments, sub-contractors, and suppliers, and ensure the resources are allocated efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
Operations Management Excellence
Plan and oversee daily construction operations, ensuring projects are completed on schedule and within budget.
Build and maintain strong relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, regulatory bodies and internal teams.
Ensure compliance with all Safety regulations, local codes, and environmental guidelines.
Develop and monitor Project Timelines, budgets, resource allocation and preparing regular reports for senior management.
Conduct site visits to ensure project progress and quality.
Implement and improve operational processes for efficiency and cost control to minimize wastage and maximize profitability.
Liaise with clients and stakeholders to ensure project expectations are met.
Train and supervise site managers, engineers, foremen, and administrative staff.
Develop and enforce operational policies, procedures, and best practices.
Lead procurement and logistics for construction materials and equipment.
Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure smooth project delivery.
Foster a culture of teamwork, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Sales & Business Development Leadership
Develop and Implement strategies to grow Sales expand market presence.
Identify new business opportunities, build client relationships, and secure contracts.
Prepare and present project proposals, bids, and quotations to prospective clients.
Negotiate terms of contracts and close sales to meet revenue targets.
Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business.
Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
Qualifications & Experiences
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or related field.
Proven experience in operations managements within the construction industry.
Strong Knowledge of construction processes, materials, and safety standards.
Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Interested applicants to attach cover letter, updated CV & a passport size photo and email to;
[email protected]
The closing date is 28 February 2026.
Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Apply

25835.description:
Assistant Lecturer - Business Management
SBM: School of Business & Management - Port Moresby, NCD
Position Title: Assistant Lecturer – Business Management
Department: Business Studies
Reports To: Academic Coordinator
Location: IBS College of TVET, Mt Eriama, 11-mile campus, Sogeri Road
Employment Type: Full-time
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are in one of the largest business schools in the country and offer degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.
Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and future citizens of Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learned skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
Position Overview:
The Assistant Lecturer in Business Management plays a pivotal role in delivering quality education and fostering the academic development of students in business-related disciplines. This position involves assisting with teaching, curriculum development, research, and mentoring, contributing to the overall success of the Business Management Course run at IBS College of TVET.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Teaching and Learning:
Assist in preparing and delivering lectures, tutorials, and workshops in Business Management and related subjects.
Facilitate interactive learning experiences to engage students and enhance their understanding of core business concepts.
Develop teaching materials, lesson plans, and assessment tools in collaboration with senior lecturers.
2. Curriculum Development:
Support the development and periodic review of the Business Management curriculum to ensure it meets industry and academic standards.
Integrate contemporary business practices, case studies, and trends into teaching content.
3. Student Support:
Provide academic guidance and mentoring to students to help them achieve their learning objectives.
Assess and evaluate students’ performance through assignments, projects, and examinations.
4. Research and Professional Development:
Participate in research activities and encourage student involvement in research projects.
Stay updated with current business trends, practices, and theories to inform teaching methods.
5. Administrative Duties:
Maintain accurate records of student attendance, progress, and assessment outcomes.
Contribute to departmental meetings, committees, and administrative tasks as required.
6. Community Engagement:
Support outreach programs, workshops, and seminars that promote business education.
Engage with local businesses and organizations to create partnerships and learning opportunities.
Qualifications and Experience:
Education:
A Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Commerce, or a related field is essential.
A Master’s degree (or working towards one) in Business Administration or a similar discipline is highly desirable.
Experience:
At least 1–3 years of teaching or professional experience in business or management roles.
Prior experience in teaching at the tertiary or vocational education level is an advantage.
Technical Skills:
Knowledge of core business functions such as marketing, finance, management, HR management, and entrepreneurship.
Proficiency in using educational technology tools and learning management systems like Moodle and ERP
Soft Skills:
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Effective time management and organizational abilities.
A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for teaching and student success.
Key Competencies:
Ability to explain complex business concepts in an accessible and engaging manner.
Commitment to fostering a supportive and inclusive learning environment.
Adaptability to evolving educational methodologies and industry trends.
Analytical and problem-solving skills relevant to business contexts.
Benefits and Opportunities:
Opportunities for professional growth and research involvement.
Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
Access to modern teaching resources and tools.
Application Process:
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume, a cover letter, and relevant academic or professional certifications trough the link provided:
https://ibs.bamboohr.com/careers/170
IBS College of TVET is an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.
Apply

25800.description:
WE ARE HIRING!
BRANCH MANAGER (OPEN TO EXPATRIATES)
About Us:
Able Computing is a fast-growing company in the Information Technology sector. We are passionate about empowering our clients with the tools and support they need to run their businesses with maximum efficiency and reliability. We are looking for a talented and motivated individual to join our dynamic team.
The Opportunity:
As a Branch Manager, you will oversee the daily operations, sales, and service efforts of the branch, focusing on Information and Communications Technology (ICT) business software, networking, hardware, furniture, appliances, and other business services. This role requires an experienced manager with strong leadership abilities, excellent organizational skills, and a keen understanding of sales, customer service, and operational efficiency. You will ensure that the branch meets performance goals, customer satisfaction standards, and financial targets.
Responsibilities:
Branch Operations Management
Oversee all operational functions, including ICT, sales, services, and inventory management.
Ensure the branch operates within budget and achieves financial objectives.
Implement and monitor branch policies, procedures, and standards to enhance efficiency.
ICT and Technical Management
Manage and coordinate ICT business software, networking, and hardware services.
Oversee the installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of ICT equipment.
Keep updated on technology trends and ensure the branch is equipped with the latest tools to support operations and client needs.
Product and Service Oversight
Manage the branch's portfolio of ICT products, furniture, appliances, and related services.
Oversee procurement, inventory control, and vendor relations for all products.
Ensure a high standard of customer service and address client concerns efficiently.
Sales and Marketing Management
Develop and implement sales strategies to drive revenue and expand the branch’s market presence.
Oversee the sales team, set performance targets, and provide coaching and support to achieve them.
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, partners, and local businesses.
Team Leadership and Development
Recruit, train, and mentor branch staff, promoting a positive work culture and team collaboration.
Conduct regular performance reviews and identify training needs.
Promote safety, compliance, and ethical conduct within the branch.
Customer Relationship Management
Foster strong customer relationships and ensure exceptional service.
Address client inquiries and complaints, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution.
Regularly gather and respond to customer feedback to improve services and products.
Reporting and Compliance
Prepare and submit regular performance, financial, and operational reports.
Ensure the branch complies with all company policies, regulations, and legal standards.
What we're looking for:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in branch management, preferably with experience in ICT, furniture, or appliance sales.
Proven experience in managing sales and customer service teams.
Must have good background in selling copiers
Strong knowledge of ICT business software, networking, hardware, and retail services.
Excellent leadership, organizational, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Driving skills
What we offer:
Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
A collaborative and supportive work environment.
Paid 4 weeks annual leave with return airfare
Housing with free utilities
Vehicle after hours
Mobile phone with data
Profit share as per budget condition
Quarterly bonus as per budget condition
To Apply:
Please submit your resume and a cover letter to
[email protected]
Apply

Senior Lecturer - SBM: School of Business & Management - Port Moresby
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.
Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and futures citizens on Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
The Senior Lecturer plays a pivotal role to ensure we have a highly engaged and productive students that enriched through education in unison to prosper in their life goals and achievements. As the gatekeeper of our student’s success, you will promote student management best practices that can be easily digested and embraced across the organisation.
The Senior Lecturer is responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining a modern Academic function that is digital on the inside—harnessing digital + cloud technologies to effectively capture and manage all aspects of delivering the best student experience for the Institution. Overseeing and managing the entire lecturing process, you will ensure all students are engaged both academically and socially to maintain a healthy balance and effectively utilising our finite academic infrastructure resources.
The Senior Lecturer reports to the Head of School - Business and Management. This position incorporates a high degree of unsupervised work; as an outcome-focused person, you will display strong conflict resolution skills and enjoy managing your workload and being part of a productive team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
In a highly student-focused role, the Senior Lecturer should focus on strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. It is also essential that you understand Global Management Best Practices, and local industry trends. Senior Lecturer duties will involve managing and monitoring undergraduate programmes. This includes associated operational administration, curriculum development, course materials review and quality management and enhancement.  Senior Lecturer duties include but are not limited to the following:
Learning & Teaching
Ensure quality of tutor classes and complete the assigned syllabus within the scheduled time
Use all the available teaching aids for better understanding and delivery of the units
Ensure the benchmark for lectures is achieved in the KPM’s at the end of the semester
Tutor specific academic subjects to individuals or small groups
Monitor student’s attendance and progress
Use pre-determined Institution resources to deliver the tutoring as outlined
Lesson Preparation, Assessment & Examination Duties
Design, develop and prepare and conduct face-to-face, online and co-operative programs as allocated that inspire strong discussions and keep students interested and engaged
Ensure that unit / course design and delivery comply with quality standards and regulations of the University and College
Assist in the conduct of examinations (e.g., paper setting, marking, supervision and invigilation)
Prepare and Submit DRMS in a timely manner
Student Learning Experience
Provide a high-quality learning experience to students, assisting them to achieve prescribed learning outcomes
Supervise student projects and academic elements of field trips as and when required
Supporting students’ extra-curricular activities
Coordinate meetings and schedules with tutees as appropriate
Student Pastoral Care
Research, Scholarship & Innovation:
Engage in research, scholarly activity and/or innovation, subject to the approval of the Head of School
Engage with other researchers internally, nationally & internationally to contribute to the research objectives of the respected School and Institutions research centres
To engaged in subject and professional research development as required and relevant to support teaching activities
Be active and recognised contributor to subject association and relevant professional bodies
Curriculum Development:

Responsible for designing and delivery of modules and assessment methods

Designing and delivery of Curriculum
General Duties:
Attend and present at relevant conferences and share knowledge and insights gained with the other schools when required
Liaise closely with teaching, technical and administration
Taking administrative responsibilities as requested by your Head of School, Division, and Registrar
Participate in professional development activities to improve tutorial skill and continue to grow cultural competence.
Provide support as a team member in other operational activities as and when requires
Participate in Institutions staff development initiatives relating to learning & teaching

Master’s Degree or Higher in any of the following fields: Business, Economics or any related course
At least 3 years experience in teaching
Well-developed interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with students and all levels of employees and management
Excellent business judgement, analytical and decision-making skills
Ability to review programme design on a regular basis to ensure compliance with quality standards and academic regulations and to make alterations where appropriate.

Ability to use a range of delivery techniques to enthuse and engage students

25792.description:
Senior Lecturer - School of Economics & Development Studies - Port Moresby
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field. Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and futures citizens of Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and we believe that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
The Senior Lecturer plays a pivotal role to ensure we have a highly engaged and productive students that enriched through education in unison to prosper in their life goals and achievements. As the gatekeeper of our student’s success, you will promote student management best practices that can be easily digested and embraced across the organisation.
The Senior Lecturer is responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining a modern Academic function that is digital on the inside—harnessing digital + cloud technologies to effectively capture and manage all aspects of delivering the best student experience for the Institution. Overseeing and managing the entire lecturing process, you will ensure all students are engaged both academically and socially to maintain a healthy balance and effectively utilising our finite academic infrastructure resources.
The Senior Lecturer reports to the respective Head of School. This position incorporates a high degree of unsupervised work; as an outcome-focused person, you will display strong conflict resolution skills and enjoy managing your workload and being part of a productive team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
In a highly student-focused role, the Senior Lecturer should focus on strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. It is also essential that you understand Global Management Best Practices, and local industry trends. Senior Lecturer duties will involve managing and monitoring undergraduate programmes. This includes associated operational administration, curriculum development, course materials review and quality management and enhancement. Senior Lecturer duties include but are not limited to the following:
Learning & Teaching
Ensure quality of tutor classes and complete the assigned syllabus within the scheduled time
Use all the available teaching aids for better understanding and delivery of the units
Ensure the benchmark for lectures is achieved in the KPM’s at the end of the semester

Monitor student’s attendance and progress
Use pre-determined Institution resources to deliver the tutoring as outlined
Lesson Preparation, Assessment & Examination Duties
Design, develop and prepare and conduct face to face, online and co-operative programs as allocated that inspire strong discussions and keep students interested and engaged
Ensure that unit/course design and delivery comply with quality standards and regulations of the University and College
Assist in the conduct of examinations (e.g., paper setting, marking, supervision and invigilation)
Prepare and Submit DRMS in a timely manner
Student Learning Experience
Provide a high-quality learning experience to students, assisting them to achieve prescribed learning outcomes
Supervise student projects and academic elements of field trips as and when required
Supporting students’ extra-curricular activities
Coordinate meetings and schedules with tutees as appropriate
Student Pastoral Care
Research, Scholarship & Innovation:
Engage in research, scholarly activity and/or innovation, subject to the approval of the Head of School
Engage with other researchers internally, nationally & internationally to contribute to the research objectives of the respected School and Institutions research centres
To engaged in subject and professional research development as required and relevant to support teaching activities
Be active and recognised contributor to subject association and relevant professional bodies
Curriculum Development:
Develop & produce appropriate learning materials
Responsible for designing and delivery of modules and assessment methods
Develop course/unit materials of relevance to the highest quality for undergraduate programmes
Designing and delivery of Curriculum
General Duties:
Attend and present at relevant conferences and share knowledge and insights gained with the other schools when required
Liaise closely with teaching, technical and administration
Taking administrative responsibilities as requested by your Head of School, Division, and Registrar
Participate in professional development activities to improve tutorial skill and continue to grow cultural competence.
Provide support as a team member in other operational activities as and when requires
Participate in Institutions staff development initiatives relating to learning & teaching

Master’s Degree or Higher in any of the following fields: Economics or any Business related course
At least 3 years experience in teaching
Well-developed interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with students and all levels of employees and management
Excellent business judgement, analytical and decision-making skills
Ability to review programme design on a regular basis to ensure compliance with quality standards and academic regulations and to make alterations where appropriate.
Ability to demonstrate equivalent core knowledge in units taken
Ability to use a range of delivery techniques to enthuse and engage students

Sound Computer skills

Effective time management skills and attention to detail

Experience working in a tertiary environment

25791.description:
Head of Research
Research - Port Moresby, NCD
IBSUNIVERSITY
ROLE DESCRIPTION
ROLE TITLE : Head of Research
ROLE ID : HOR-001
DEPARTMENT : RESEARCH
DIVISION : IBSUniversity
ROLE TERM : 24 MONTHS
ROLE TYPE : FULLTIME
EFFECTIVE DATE: : TBA
REPORTING TO : PRO VICE-CHANCELLOR (Academic)
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades &  Associates, primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private university-level Institution over the last thirty-four years. It was elevated as a University in January 2017 and offers its own degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies, and Information Technology.
Today, we are one of the largest business schools in the country and continue to grow into the future. These successes are the fruits of our dedicated team members’ commitment to making a
difference in Papua New Guinea through their efforts in helping educate fellow citizens.
The University has been affiliated with the Southern Cross University (SCU) of Australia since 1999
and offers its degree programmes in Accounting, Business, and Information Technology. The
affiliation with Southern Cross University has made IBS the first and only Institution to offer
internationally recognised Bachelor programmes face-to-face in Papua New Guinea.
We strive to be the pioneer institution for business education in PNG. Some of our accomplishments
to date are listed below:
Only educational Institution to operate a Career Centre.
Only the organisation has a “Centre of Excellence” for Leadership & Management Development.
Only private University established as per the decision of NEC and Gazettal.
Only private Institution to hold the status of “Study Centre – for the University of Papua New Guinea.” Till 2016, for 22 years.
Examination Centre for the majority of Australian & NZ Universities.
Test Centre for ICDL, CISCO, Pearson VUE & Prometric.
Established partnerships with Oracle Academy, Red Hat Academy, and the All-India Management Association (AIMA), among others.
To bridge the gap between academia and industry, facilitated Memoranda of Understanding with organisations such as BSP, Telikom, CPL, Vodafone, Women’s Micro Bank, Theodist, Barlow Industries, and CEFI.
First, publish bi-annual Journal of Business & Research in Papua New Guinea.
Accredited professional bodies in PNG & Australia and ISO 9001:2015 certified University.
As a private tertiary institution, our survival and growth depend heavily on high-quality teaching,
learning, and impactful research that strengthens our reputation and attracts students and
partners. The role of the Head of Research needs to be modern, innovative, and strategically
positioned.
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Head of Research will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight to promote a
research culture of excellence, innovation, and integrity at IBSUniversity. This role is central to
strengthening the University’s research systems, advancing staff capacity, fostering student
research engagement, and ensuring alignment with national higher education priorities.
The role includes academic engagement through teaching two units - one each from
IBSUniversity and Southern Cross University - to strengthen the connection between teaching
and research, and to better understand student expectations and academic progression.
The Director of Research will also support the broader institutional strategy by ensuring that all
research activities are in harmony with the expectations of the Department of Higher Education,
Research, Science and Technology (DHERST), contribute to the University’s strategic goals, and
uphold the Vision, Mission, Values, and non-negotiable IBS Culture.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1.1. Strategic Research Leadership
Implement the University’s research strategy, policies, and annual research plan.
Promote a culture of research excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration across schools and faculties aligning research priorities with Papua New Guinea’s national development goals.
2.2. Academic Contribution through Teaching
Undertake two units per semester (one IBSU, one SCU) to maintain academic connection and student engagement.
Use teaching to identify talent and cultivate a research mindset among students and faculty.
2.3. Research Management and Capacity Building
Oversee the planning, execution, and dissemination of research projects.
Organize and conduct of National and International Conference.
Continue to publish “IBSU Journal of Business and Research” biannual journal.
Support faculty and postgraduate students (Commencement of master’s Programme from 2026) in developing research proposals, securing grants, and publishing in reputable journals.
Student Satisfaction – Support University with regular surveys on teaching quality, campus facilities, learning resources, and career support and employee satisfaction.
New program recommendations-Support university to identify the requirements for future programs/courses.
Analysis & Reporting – Consolidating findings into actionable recommendations for  curriculum design, student services, and industry engagement. Organize training, workshops, and seminars to strengthen research skills and capacity within the University.
2.4.  Research Partnerships and Funding
Establish and maintain collaborations with local and international universities, industry partners, government agencies, and NGOs.
Lead efforts to secure research grants and external funding to support institutional projects.
Represent IBSUniversity at national and international research forums.
2.5. Research Governance and Quality Assurance
Chair the University Research Committee and oversee research ethics and compliance processes for the publication by the faculty members.
Monitor research outputs, impact, and performance indicators to ensure continuous
improvement.
2.6. Administration and Documentation
Prepare research reports, policy briefs, and publications for internal and external stakeholders.
Manage the research budget and allocate resources effectively.
Contribute to the University’s accreditation and quality assurance processes.
KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
The following criteria are considered to be ESSENTIAL:
Master’s degree or higher in Research, Education, Social Sciences, Business, or a related field (PhD preferred).
Proven track record in research leadership, academic publishing, or managing research projects.
Strong ability to analyze and synthesize complex data into clear, evidence-based insights.
Demonstrated capacity to secure research funding, develop proposals, and manage grants.
Excellent academic writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate research findings to diverse audiences.
Proven critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to design and implement innovative research strategies.
Ability to foster and maintain effective collaborative relationships with colleagues, research partners, funding agencies, and external stakeholders.
High standards of research ethics, integrity, and professionalism, with a proactive and positive attitude.
Strong project management and time management skills, with the ability to deliver outputs within tight deadlines.
Exceptional attention to detail in research design, analysis, and reporting.
The following criteria are considered to be DESIRABLE:
Experience working in a tertiary education or higher education research environment.
Experience in mentoring, supervising, or coaching academic staff and/or student researchers.
Demonstrated skills in developing research policies, frameworks, and institutional strategies.
Experience in community-based research, applied research, or projects with measurable social impact.
OTHER ROLE RELATED INFORMATION
The role is based at IBS Mt Eriama Campus but is required and support the responsive delivery of services and to maintain liaison with all key stakeholders.
The role is also required to liaise with external regulatory authorities at their place of business outside University premises.
Some attendance outside normal working hours may be required from time to time for effective performance of the position.

Autoclaves Supervisor – Processing (233957)
Porgera, Enga, Papua New Guinea
Job Description
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Processing -Department as a
Autoclaves Supervisor - Processing.
About the role
Reporting to the Process Foreman, the Autoclave Supervisor is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the autoclave circuit, leading a team of operators to deliver reliable production performance while upholding the highest standards of process safety and environmental compliance. This role requires hands-on autoclave operational experience, a strong understanding of high-pressure process safety, and the ability to drive positive change in work practices, team culture, and plant performance. A key accountability of this role is the development and training of both national and local staff, ensuring the transfer of technical knowledge and building long-term operational capability within the workforce.
In this role, you will:
Lead day-to-day operation of the autoclave and associated circuits to ensure production targets are met safely and efficiently.
Supervise, coach, and develop autoclave operators, ensuring adherence to safe operating procedures and compliance with permits and regulatory standards.
Monitor process conditions, troubleshoot deviations, and coordinate corrective actions to maintain plant stability and product quality.
Champion process safety by enforcing critical controls, conducting safety interactions, and fostering a strong safety culture.
Drive the structured development and training of national and local staff, ensuring competency growth, knowledge transfer, and career progression opportunities.
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and technical teams to plan and execute shutdowns, inspections, and repairs.
Ensure accurate reporting of shift activities, production data, and incidents into plant systems.
Contribute to operator training programs, competency assessments, and continuous skills development.
Maintain a high level of health, safety and environmental awareness and comply with all relevant NPL policies & procedures.
About You
To
succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:
Proven operational experience in POX autoclave circuits.
Demonstrated leadership ability in supervising teams in a processing environment.
Strong understanding of process safety principles (e.g., high pressure, high temperature, hazardous materials).
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to communicate effectively across teams and disciplines, with a focus on mentoring and capability development.
Commitment to fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
High level of initiative with an eagerness to drive positive change and challenge the status quo.
Mobilization Requirement
This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately. Females are encouraged to apply.
Join Our Team as a Autoclaves Supervisor - Processing
Embark on a rewarding career with New Porgera Limited as a
Autoclaves Supervisor - Processing
. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. Enjoy a balanced work schedule, competitive compensation, and a chance to develop your career and technical expertise in a supportive and professional environment.
Note:
This advert will be open until
26
th
of
February,2026
. If you do not hear from NPL within next two (2) weeks following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.
Apply

26137.description:
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Purpose
The
Reliability Engineer
will improve the safety, availability, and life-cycle performance of process plant assets by preventing mechanical failures through proactive reliability engineering, data-driven analysis, and continuous improvement.
Essential Duties
Identify issues/defects and improvement opportunities by analyzing equipment performance, process delays, costs, asset management KPI’s and maintenance history in SAP
Develop project plans for reliability improvement initiatives in line with Newmont’s Defect Elimination Process
Develop and manage equipment maintenance strategies using Reliability Centered Maintenance methodology and PM optimization for existing strategies on equipment not meeting availability or reliability requirements
Compile and distribute key asset performance indicators including availability and utilization
Facilitate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions using RCA guidelines to identify failure causes, containment and counter measures as necessary
Develop lifecycle cost models for critical assets and monitor and quantify equipment lifecycle costs
Investigate and adopt alternative strategies to support capital replacement plan
Actively participate and contribute to safety improvements and environmental awareness.
Training & Experience
A committment to Safety
Bachelor’s Degree qualification in Mechanical Engineering
Registered with IEPNG
Demonstrated fixed plant reliability engineering experience in large-scale mine operations
Understanding of mining industry asset maintenance and reliability methods i.e. defect elimination, criticality analysis, asset strategy development, operate for reliability, condition monitoring, etc
Understanding of safety compliance and regulations
Knowledge of root cause analysis, problem solving, and other analytical techniques
Knowledge of mine operations Fixed Plant and mine processing equipment
Knowledge of maintenance strategies, Master data management and Reliability Centred Maintenance principles
Experience in Failure Modes Effects Analysis facilitation and workshop delivery
Skills in mining industry specific failure metrics and data analytics – i.e. MTBF, MTTR
Working Conditions
This is a FIFO role on a 21:21 roster.
If you feel that you could make a meaningful contribution in this role, we encourage you to discuss this opportunity with your current people leader and how it aligns with your longer term career goals.
To support you in your application, we have created a range of resources available to all Newmont People including information on eligibility criteria and FAQs. Find out more by visiting our page in Discovery: Internal Employee Resources
As a current employee or contractor, please submit your application is MS Word or Adobe format online via the Internal Job Postings link on Discovery.
If you have issues applying through Discovery or would like to learn more about the role before applying, please contact the relevant member of our Talent Acquisition Team.
Apply

26079.description:
Provincial Trainer – Education and Social Emotional Learning Project
ChildFund PNG is seeking a committed and skilled Provincial trainer to deliver School Leadership and Social Emotional Learning (SEL) training to secondary school leaders, teachers, and students in project target areas. The role plays a key part in strengthening school leadership, promoting safe and inclusive school environments, and building the leadership capacity of young people.
This position require regular travel to remote and rural communities and close collaboration with provincial education offices, school leaders, students, and ChildFund project staff.
PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
Provincial Trainer is responsible for delivering training and monitoring progress against project targets for Head Teachers, Principals, School Boards of Management (BoM), using the School Leadership Management Training Package. This role is responsible for working closely with secondary school students and building leadership, GEDSI skills to ensure proper peer to peer support mechanism in targeted schools using Rights, Responsibility and Resilience  for Respectful Relationship training. The role requires regular travel to remote locations to conduct trainings within schools. Provincial Trainers will also follow up with schools to support the development and implementation of School Learning Improvement Plans (SLIPs) and Behaviour Management Plans. In addition, the Provincial Trainer will work closely with provincial partners to coordinate training logistics, including school and teacher selection, preparation of training venues, and scheduling of district-level trainings. The position requires maintaining regular, open communication with Lead Trainers and the Provincial Liaison Officer (PLO) to ensure smooth coordination of training activities, logistics, and provincial office requirements.
Key Duties
Deliver School Leadership and 5R Learning Resource Manual (LRM) trainings to achieve project targets and outcomes, ensuring GEDSI, Child Protection, and Safe Schools principles are mainstreamed across all sessions.
Facilitate Safe Schools and respectful relationships sessions with secondary school students, strengthening student leadership, peer-to-peer support mechanisms, and positive behaviour.
Provide follow-up support to trained school leaders on the development and implementation of School Learning Improvement Plans (SLIPs), Behaviour Management Plans, and delivery of 5R sessions, in collaboration with provincial and district-level staff.
Review and provide technical advice on draft plans to strengthen quality, effectiveness, and stakeholder engagement.
Participate in regular coordination meetings with project staff to review progress, identify challenges and risks, and develop corrective or mitigation actions in consultation with Lead Trainers, PDOE, and District Officers.
Work with school leaders and teachers to strengthen parental and community engagement in children’s learning, school planning, and the implementation of school development and behaviour management plans.
Prepare timely training and activity reports for each project target area, highlighting effective practices, lessons learned, and challenges encountered.
Contribute to training planning in target areas, anticipate operational risks, and support contingency planning; assist with administrative and financial requirements as required.
Work closely with sub-national NDOE counterparts (provincial and district levels) to plan, deliver, and monitor project activities.
Ensure full compliance with ChildFund’s policies, safeguarding standards, and procedures.
Qualification & Experience:
Degree or Diploma in Education, Social Work, Adult Education, or a related discipline recognized in PNG.
Experience working with secondary school students and young people, including facilitating Safe Schools or respectful relationships activities.
Experience working in INGO in implementing, managing, coordination educational programs
Sound understanding of the PNG education system, school leadership, and school management processes.
Demonstrated experience in training, mentoring, and coaching teachers, school leaders, or young people to achieve positive outcomes.
Experience delivering training in diverse and remote settings in PNG.
Sound knowledge of quantitative and qualitative monitoring and reporting
Desirable:
Experience trainer, school Inspector in PNG.
Knowledge of participatory adult learning methodologies.
Experience in child rights, Safe Schools, SLIP training.
Skills:
Strong training skills – confidence, clarity and responsiveness
Ability to engage trainees from a diverse setting.
Strong organizational and planning skills and ability to meet deadlines.
Sound evaluative skills, able to assess trainees progress and make adjustments where necessary.
Flexible and willing to travel to project target areas.
Safeguarding
Remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse or harassment (SEAH) risks, acquire relevant knowledge and skills to promote strong safeguarding practices, understand the child safeguarding and PSEAH policy and procedures, and conduct yourself consistent with those policies
Appointment to this position is subject to
criminal background checks and reference checks.
How to Apply:
To apply, please visit:
https://teamchildfund.bamboohr.com/careers/636
Applications closing date:  Friday 27 February 2026
Housing will not be provided by ChildFund.
This position is open to Papua New Guinea nationals only.
Apply

ADMINISTRATIVE CLERK (LAE)
About Us:
Able Computing is a fast-growing company in the Information Technology sector. We are passionate about empowering our clients with the tools and support they need to run their businesses with maximum efficiency and reliability. We are looking for a talented and motivated individual to join our dynamic team.
The Opportunity:
The Administration Clerk plays a key role in supporting the smooth and efficient operation of the organization by providing comprehensive administrative and clerical support. 25589.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role you will direct, manage and ensure that mobile equipment repair is carried out in a productive and cost-effective manner to optimize mobile machinery availability and facilitate the delivery of Mining Services underground so productions targets can be met. You will provide management and leadership within our mobile maintenance department, and this rewarding role will see you provide daily mentoring, guidance, instruction, and training to the national workforce to increase safety performance, machinery uptime and efficient outcomes within a motivated and talented department.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Supervise all maintenance Personnel in the workshop, including recruitment and termination of personnel.
Liaise closely with the Production Superintendent in respect of equipment servicing and preventive maintenance scheduling and required equipment availability.
Supervise and control any sub-contractor activity at the workshop.
Supervise all workshop apprentices under the guidance of the Apprenticeship Co-ordinator.
Prepare estimates and quotes on repairs for work to be carried out in the workshop where applicable
Regularly assess and determine if upgrades are required and check designs of buckets booms and GET meet site and manufacturer’s specification in conjunction with HOD Mining.
Provide support to the Mine Superintendent to optimize efficiencies in the underground mine to achieve the Weekly Plan.
Work closely with the Mine Superintendent and Shift Supervisors to improve mining standards, assess operator performance and identify improvement projects to maximize results, reduce risk and implement cost management initiatives.
Establish a high-performance culture by motivating team members to strive for a high level of performance by rewarding and recognizing high performance.
Ensure effective processes for communicating relevant information, including company, site, department, and team performance, to all team members are in place.
Continuously mentor and coach operators on acceptable mining standards and effective techniques on machinery to achieve these standards.
Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.
Coordinate and assist with the delivery of training to employees.
Actively review the work performance of technicians and provide feedback to the area supervisors including the talent and succession planning for designated key roles.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Ensure general housekeeping within the mine is of a high standard.
Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have
Relevant trade qualification in Heavy Equipment Fitting, Auto Electrical and Automation
5+ years plus of underground mining experience (Essential)
2+ years Shift Supervisor experience (Essential)
Organizational skills – Good time management skills.
Good communication and interpersonal skills – Be an effective communicator and listener.
Extensive knowledge of SHE Management System relevant to K92 i.e. Policy and Procedures.
Supervisory skills – Be a good leader, motivator and teacher.
Good command of the English Language (oral & written).
Knowledge of various heavy earthmoving machinery components.
Knowledge and understanding of the Duty of Care standards, occupational Health & Safety Act & Regulations, Mining Inspection Act & Regulations.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

25577.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position will be responsible for testing of soils, concrete, aggregates and other construction materials.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include:
Perform a full range of soil and concrete tests following standard procedures and ensure accurate data entry and reporting.
Implement quality control measures, document non-conformances, and ensure compliance with project specifications, company policies, and safety standards.
Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair laboratory equipment to ensure optimal functionality.
Keep the laboratory clean and organized while managing workflow and supporting project deliverables.
Mentor and oversee the performance of the laboratory crew to build capability and maintain high standards.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have
5-10 years of related lab experience, including soil, aggregate and concrete.
Possess current Level 5 accreditation with National Association of Testing Authorities (NATA) Australia (desirable).
Good knowledge of lab testing procedures in accordance with relevant Australian Standards
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, MS Word and Excel)
Available to work overtime when required.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

26167.description:
Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment (PNGUNRE)
About the University
The Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment (PNGUNRE) is a specialised national institution mandated to advance education, research, innovation, and community engagement in sustainable agriculture, natural resource management, environmental stewardship, and applied development disciplines.
PNGUNRE operates across three campuses:
Vudal Main Campus (East New Britain Province) – home to core teaching and research programs
Takubar Campus (Kokopo) – host of Postgraduate Programs and the Department of Business & Economics
Popondetta Campus (Oro Province) – focused on agricultural training and community development initiatives
The University emphasises practice-oriented teaching, field-based learning, and strong industry collaboration, producing graduates who are work-ready and capable of contributing meaningfully to sustainable development outcomes across Papua New Guinea.
About the Role
PNGUNRE invites applications from suitably qualified and motivated candidates for appointment as Administrative Assistant within the Department of Forestry, School of Natural Resources.
The position is based at the Vudal Campus, East New Britain Province, and provides essential administrative and clerical support to ensure the effective day-to-day operation of the Department. The role supports academic, research, and student activities through efficient office administration, record management, and communication support.
The appointee will report directly to the Head of Department, Forestry.
Key Responsibilities
Provide general office administration support, including managing correspondence, filing systems, and departmental documentation.
Assist students with enquiries, forms, and routine departmental administrative processes.
Support basic financial administration, including procurement requests, budget tracking, and expense documentation.
Maintain accurate records of staff, students, and departmental activities in accordance with university requirements.
Draft official correspondence, notices, and departmental communications.
Monitor office supplies and liaise with procurement and central services for replenishment.
Assist with departmental reporting and ensure compliance with university administrative and policy requirements.
Support meetings, workshops, and departmental activities as required.
Perform other duties as reasonably directed by the immediate supervisor.
Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in an administrative or clerical role, preferably within an academic or public sector environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), email systems, and basic database management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (Tok Pisin proficiency is an advantage).
Demonstrated organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with staff, students, and external stakeholders.
High standards of integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
Salary Range
Administrative Assistant
Technical Officer
K19,867.00 – K24,339.0
Why Join PNGUNRE?
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the efficient administration of academic and research programs in a national institution supporting sustainable development in Papua New Guinea. PNGUNRE provides a supportive working environment that values professionalism, teamwork, and service excellence.
Application Details
Interested applicants should submit:
A cover letter addressing suitability for the role
A detailed Curriculum Vitae
Certified copies of academic qualifications
Names and contact details of three (3) referees
Applications must be addressed to:
The Manager – Human Resources
Papua New Guinea University of Natural Resources and Environment
Vudal Campus, East New Britain Province
Email:
[email protected]
Closing Date: 25 February 2026
PNGUNRE is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from suitably qualified candidates.
Apply

26144.description:
Porgera|
Geologist - Underground (236564)
Porgera, Enga, Papua New Guinea
Hot Job
Trending
Job Description
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Mineral Resources Department as
Geologist- Underground.
About the role
Reporting to the Senior Underground Geologist, the Underground Geologist is responsible for supporting and developing
the orebody definition through underground mapping, sampling, data interpretation, and reconciliation. This role plays a key part in ensuring efficient resource extraction by providing timely and accurate geological information to mine planning and operations teams.
In this role, you will:
Conduct underground geological mapping and face sampling
Ensure accurate and timely geological data capture using mine software and databases.
Log and sample underground diamond drill core (if applicable).
Update 3D geological models in coordination with resource geologists.
Communicate geological information to mine operations to support production and development activities.
Monitor ore and waste boundaries and ensure compliance with mine design.
Assist in ore mark-ups and dilution control.
Liaise with survey and engineering teams to ensure alignment of plans and geological reality.
Contribute to daily, weekly, and monthly geological reports and reconciliation of mined material vs. resource models.
Monitor ore production to ensure grade and tonnage targets are met.
Contribute to the improvement of geological systems, processes, and standards.
Provide feedback and suggestions for improved ore control and data collection practices.
Maintain a high level of health, safety and environmental awareness and comply with all relevant NPL policies & procedures.
About You
To
succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:
Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geoscience, or a related field
Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in an underground mining environment.
Strong skills in underground mapping and sampling.
Proficiency in geological software such as Datamine, Leapfrog, Deswik or similar.
Familiarity with mining operations and ore control practices.
Experience with underground diamond drilling programs.
Knowledge of resource modeling and reconciliation practices.
Previous experience with mine site databases (e.g., acQuire, Datashed).
Mobilization Requirement
This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately. Females are encouraged to apply.
Join Our Team as a Geologist – Underground
Embark on a rewarding career with New Porgera Limited as a Geologist - Underground. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. Enjoy a balanced work schedule, competitive compensation, and a chance to develop your career and technical expertise in a supportive and professional environment.
Note:
This advert will be open until
24th
of
February,2026
. If you do not hear from NPL within next two (2) weeks following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.
Apply

26110.description:
With more than 40 years of experience working in PNG, World Vision International Papua New Guinea (WVIPNG) focuses on helping the most vulnerable children and adults experience fullness of life.  Inspired by our Christian faith, WVPNG has an exciting opportunity for someone who may be looking for a change and wants to become part of a dynamic team helping vulnerable people and communities.
World Vision International Papua New Guinea (WVIPNG) has an exciting opportunity for those of you who want a change and want to become part of a dynamic team. We are currently looking for a suitable, qualified, experienced, and highly motivated professional to fill the role of
Education Technical Specialist
to be based in
Port Moresby, National Capital District.
PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
MAJOR ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This role provides technical leadership across the full education grant lifecycle, including framework development, readiness assessments, baseline studies, implementation, and integration of education policies to ensure strong processes, aligned plans, and quality reporting. It oversees education implementation through field support, evaluations, data quality assurance, and consultancy management to ensure results, learning, and credible evidence inform decision-making and grant performance. The role also leads reporting, knowledge management, tools development, learning, and capacity strengthening by supporting staff and partners, disseminating lessons learned, implementing evaluation recommendations, and strengthening education capacity and collaboration at national and sector levels.
Education Grant Framework & Planning
Develop the overall framework for grant EDUCATION in accordance to the design document and donor requirements, ensuring an effective EDUCATION framework is in place.
Identify the core information needs of grant management, partners, and funding agencies; participate in development of the annual work plan and budget, ensuring alignment with technical strategy so that EDUCATION is aligned to grant objectives and the EDUCATION Plan is in place and budget available on time.
Contribute substantial information and analyses to interdepartmental working groups on the education sector, ensuring stakeholders are included in the EDUCATION process as appropriate.
Education Grant Readiness, Design & Baseline Assessment
Conduct readiness assessment: the incentives at the system level, the beneficiaries and existing capacity, ensuring strong EDUCATION processes are applied.
Give technical lead on the development, processing and administration of the grant projects in the education sector, ensuring the education design and project plan is in place.
Provide technical leadership and integrate Grant Education policies and guidelines in the design and implementation of education projects, ensuring EDUCATION reports are available.
Identify the requirement for collecting baseline data, prepare terms-of-reference for and arrange the conduct of a baseline survey, as required, ensuring the baseline research report is available.
Education Implementation, Evaluation & Data Quality Assurance
Oversee and execute EDUCATION activities with particular focus on results and impacts as well as in lesson learnt, ensuring strong EDUCATION processes are applied.
Undertake regular visits to the field to support the implementation of EDUCATION and to identify where adaptations might be needed, ensuring EDUCATION reports are available and include lessons learnt.
Clarify and/or facilitate the process for the technical evaluation of the Grant project’s implementation process and progress, ensuring strong EDUCATION processes are applied.
Identify the need and draw up the ToRs for specific studies; recruit, guide and supervise consultants or organisations that are contracted to implement special surveys and studies required for evaluating grant effects and impacts, ensuring well-documented and targeted consultancy outcomes, if consultants are hired to support EDUCATION.
Perform regular field visits to ensure the quality of data collected by Programs and to verify the accuracy of reported data, ensuring field staff is included in the EDUCATION process as appropriate, and sub-grantees demonstrate the required M&C capacity and produce quality EDUCATION reports
Education Reporting, Knowledge Management & Tools Development
Work closely with Project managers/ Coordinators, M & E Coordinator, and the education project team in preparing the progress reports in accordance with approved reporting formats and ensure their timely submission, including quarterly progress reports, annual project reports, inception reports, and ad-hoc technical reports, ensuring reporting is submitted on time.
Prepare consolidation progress reports for grant management, including identification of problems, causes of potential bottlenecks in the project implementation, and providing specific recommendations, ensuring high-quality reporting is in place with actionable next steps and learning and major challenges are anticipated and mitigation actions planned.
Identify strengths and weaknesses in existing data collection and management systems and propose solutions to improve knowledge management activities, ensuring high-quality reporting is in place with actionable next steps and learning.
Draft tools/manuals (eg. Teacher Training, Coaching, etc.) and their revisions as well as data collection procedures (eg. logical framework, project performance tracking, indicators, data flow chart, EDUCATION manuals), ensuring teacher training manuals, coaching guide/tools reviewed and updated.
Learning, Evaluation & Capacity Strengthening
Design and implement a system to identify, analyze, document and disseminate lessons learned, ensuring lessons learnt and refresher training are well documented and include NO stakeholders and proper communication of EDUCATION findings at all levels.
Monitor the follow up on evaluation recommendations, ensuring evaluation recommendations are implemented.
Support project/program staff on ways to properly document, organize and capture program progress, ensuring proper communication of EDUCATION findings at all levels.
Facilitate, act as resource person, and join, if required any technical supervision and evaluation initiatives, ensuring EDUCATION expertise is available to the grants team and stakeholders.
Organize (and provide) refresher training in EDUCATION for grants staff, implementing partners, local organizations and primary stakeholders with view of strengthening local EDUCATION capacity, ensuring EDUCATION Capacity is provided to grants team and stakeholders and local expertise is built.
Network with external and WV internal partners to promote learning and achieve EDUCATION excellence, ensuring external networking is in place and WV represented in relevant TWGs and cluster (eg. Education Cluster).
EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION/SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE
Advanced degree (Master’s) in Education, Economics, Public Policy or closely-related Social Science field from an internationally recognized university, or bachelors degree with equivalent experience
At least 10 years of professional experience in the successful development and implementation of literacy and/or community education/early learning programs, education policy development; including at least 3 years of experience providing technical leadership in education for large, complex grant-funded projects involving multiple partners in developing countries
Minimum of 5 years of experience living or working in a developing country is desirable; experience living or working in a Pacific island nation is preferred
Experience working with government agencies and non-governmental partners to address sector challenges and drive education reforms
Experience with programming to address gender and protection concerns and programming for very young children and adolescents/youth required
Proven experience in mentorship and staff capacity building
Experience providing direct instruction for elementary- or primary-school-aged children
Experience leading capacity building initiatives and/or developing adult education materials for low-literacy audiences
Strong knowledge in literacy and learning; specific experience in one or more of the areas of materials development, conduct of teacher training, teacher education and/or language and literacy policy reform is desired
Strong analytical skills required
Proven skills in report writing
Fluency in English is required.
Strong interpersonal, writing and oral presentation skills in English are also required.
Professional working proficiency in Tok Pisin is viewed as an asset
Teaching experience.
Development of Manuals/tools for teacher capacity building/development especially in the areas of literacy and numeracy as well as coaching.
Regular travel to field offices and communities in Provinces required
Willingness to work in insecure environments
A competitive salary, benefits, and career development opportunity will be offered commensurate with relevant experience, knowledge, and qualifications.

26066.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Compliance Officer is responsible for designing, implementing, and monitoring internal AML/CTF procedures and policies relating to record keeping, reporting, risk assessment, customer due diligence measures, and management control systems. The Officer will also be responsible for organizing and conducting training for staff on anti-money laundering procedures and for receiving internal disclosures of suspected money laundering or terrorist financing activities. They will also be responsible for recommending whether there is sufficient evidence to warrant a disclosure to FASU.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop and implement internal policies and procedures relating to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations.
Advise management of any implications of changes to internal policies and procedures.
Implement the annual compliance plan and perform relevant quality assurance checks to ensure adherence
Assist in the preparation and management of inspections by financial authorities such as the FASU/BPNG.
Conduct due diligence reviews on customers and transactions.
Report results of reviews of AML/KYC risk assessments and monitor remedial proceedings.
Assist in compiling reports for the board and internal risk and compliance committees
Research and keep up to date with changes in relevant laws and regulations.
Work to develop AML and KYC guidance materials, training resources, and controls.
Plan and conduct AML/KYC training sessions for staff, as applicable
Identify, investigate, and resolve all activities that are deemed noncompliant.
Inform the relevant authorities of any breaches of laws or regulations.
Address issues relating to transaction monitoring, filtering, and sanctions.
REQUIREMENTS
Graduate degree in business studies, law, accounting, or specific training in risk management
Preferably with experience in financial institution industry with a focus on review of its compliance or similar roles such as risk and compliance management, or internal audit
Strong understanding of the regulatory and legal framework relevant to the financial institution industry
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook, and Visio
Team player who can collaborate and support colleagues and peers across the organization while still being able to work independently and professionally as needed
Results-oriented with the ability to meet deadlines on assignments, manage multiple demands, and work with individuals of various individuals within the organization
Analytical and inquisitive mindset
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
Committed to self-development
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral
